verdict.rationale: Trello's marketing claims you can 'Automate tasks and workflows with Trello' [trello-docs-3], but the evidence never describes a trigger-and-action rule builder. What an engineer can verifiably use is webhooks on the REST API [trello-docs-21] plus Power-Up board buttons [trello-docs-11], which means building automation as custom code rather than configuring rules. Missing for 10: documented trigger/action rule-builder (rule, button, scheduled automation details), examples of eliminating manual steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration that native automation works.
